text:
maria-marketing: Quick sync — finalizing the launch post + webinar landing. We need keyword mapping, schema json-ld, internal anchor plan, and redirects checklist before we push prod. Can we get sign-off today?

leo-seo: For keywords: organizing by funnel (top=intent, mid=problem-solution, bottom=product). Will list 12 prioritized kws and suggested H1/H2 placements. Focus phrases for the webinar: "inference cost", "production latency", "dedicated inference".

tasha-growth: Also want to test two messaging tracks in the post: benchmark narrative (cost/throughput) vs product story (ease of deploy + privacy). Different CTAs and UTM flows.

omar-analytics: For A/B tracking we'll need `utm_campaign=prod-inference`, and `cta_variant` param on form submit. I'll add event spec: webinar_signup (label: cta_variant, kw_group). Also will simulate expected conversions for both CTAs.

viv-ops: Heads up — redirect rules must be 301 unless temporary. Our site enforces slug length <= 64 and only hyphens for spaces. Add redirect CSV to the PR for review.

leo-seo: Draft redirect rows to add to redirects.csv:
```
/old-inference-blog,/launch/production-inference,301,intent=benchmark
/beta-webinar,/webinar/prod-inference,301,intent=signup
/post-seed,/webinar/seed-kw,302,intent=kw-capture
```
I'll include `intent=` tags as a comment column so marketing can filter later.

maria-marketing: Nice. For internal linking: we need 3 in-post anchors linking back to the product page, docs quickstart, and webinar landing. Anchor text should be top-keyword variants. Keep anchors minimal to avoid dilution.

leo-seo: I'll run an orphan-anchor sweep after we add the anchors. Also will produce a small JSON-LD package: Event (webinar meta), FAQ (3 Qs mapped to agenda), and BreadcrumbList for the post.

maria-marketing: FAQ Qs please be short and match schema expectations. Example Qs: 1) Who should attend? 2) What will be demoed? 3) How do I get access after the webinar? Keep answers 1-2 sentences.

omar-analytics: Reminder — ensure GA4 and server-side tag both capture form `cta_variant`. Add test: submit form with variant A/B and verify `webinar_signup` appears in debug view with proper params.

viv-ops: I'll open a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site/pull/482 with the slug and redirect csv. Will also add a CI check that enforces slug length and ASCII-only.

tasha-growth: CTA variants: Variant A = "See benchmark results" (funnels to benchmark narrative flow). Variant B = "Get early access" (funnels to product onboarding flow). We'll have separate thank-you pages and email sequences.

maria-marketing: Good. Action items:
- @leo-seo: final kw list + H1/H2 annotations, JSON-LD snippets (Event, FAQ, Breadcrumb).
- @tasha-growth: CTA copy + UTM mapping + two thank-you page copy drafts.
- @omar-analytics: event spec, test plan, simulated CTRs for both CTAs.
- @viv-ops: PR with redirect CSV + CI slug checks.
I will write the in-post internal anchor map and final microcopy for FAQ. Mark done in the sheet when complete.

leo-seo: I'll have KW list and JSON-LD up by 3pm PT.

tasha-growth: CTA + thank-you drafts by EOD, including email seed copy.

omar-analytics: Running sim now, will drop numbers in the sheet and the test steps.

viv-ops: PR opened and CI lint added. Requesting review from SEO and Marketing.

maria-marketing: One tiny note — please include a `rel=canonical` on the staging preview so search bots don't index staging copies. Also include `data-intent` attributes on CTA buttons for quick instrumentation.

leo-seo: Will add canonical to the header and `data-intent` attributes to CTAs.

deploy-bot: Staging build passed: deploy-2023-11-02-14. Landing preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar/prod-inference-preview

maria-marketing: Thanks team. Once SEO + Analytics confirm, I will promote to prod tomorrow morning and run the final redirect sweep. :rocket:
